entries.prompt: Extract ONE faithful isolated rigid detachable biomask from this exact official NECA Stalker Kenner tribute Series16(2016) product photograph. Use the visible MASK on the figure, preserving this actual almost-frontal camera with its slight downward head pitch, the complete rigid shell silhouette, proportions, colors, existing panels and coarse relief. This is the brown/bronze OPAQUE mask, NOT the ivory translucent head, skin or hanging dreadlocks around it. Preserve the narrow integrated tall dark CENTRAL CREST/KEEL already rising above the forehead, and the existing small upper shell corners; do not invent horns or a rear helmet. The upper forehead has the real copper-brown rectangular segmented insets divided by dark curved bands around the central black ridge, tapering into the V above the brow. Keep the two large pale gray/silver opaque reflective EYE INSERTS and their thick dark borders; no colored glow, no empty transparent eye holes. Preserve the small existing round bronze bridge detail between the eyes, the bronze curved cheek frame around the dark inset cheek shapes, the existing narrow central oval respirator with its few long vertical dark slots and the small single round port at the lower end. Keep the actual short solid lower edge under that port, not a long invented chin. Do not add any new vent, grille, glyph, symbol, screw, rivet, horn, extra band or hidden side/back geometry. The mask region is only about200px tall in the original; unknown fine details remain restrained interpretation. Preserve its apparent warm bronze/copper-brown paint and charcoal-black inset structure, subdued toy/product-photo highlights and the visible coarse photo texture. This A version should retain a faithful photographed toy/material appearance, rather than redesign or universal mirror chrome. All the milky pale translucent/greenish parts belong to the wearer and must be entirely excluded: head, skin, mandibles, neck, dreadlocks, hanging hair and hands. Also remove armor, shoulder spikes, spears and their tips behind the head, body, packaging and white photo background. Keep ONLY the rigid bronze/black face shell and gray eye inserts. TRUE transparent RGBA background, complete mask centered with8-12percent fully transparent margin above highest existing crest and below lowest port; larger side margins are fine. No floor or shadow plane, halo, glow, UI, labels, extra views, alternate mask or duplicates. One mask only.

Wearer skin/dreadlocks/translucency, armor, spears and photo background excluded; near-front primary camera retained. Fine slot/paint relief remains interpretive from a small product photo. Read-only browser composites show no visible background rectangle, wearer residue, hanging hair or clipped solid shell; opaque shell and pale eye inserts retained.
